import os, pathlib, json, fcntl
jobs=[]
unreadable=0
for p in pathlib.Path('/proc').iterdir():
 if not p.name.isdigit() or int(p.name)==os.getpid(): continue
 try:
  argv=[a.decode('utf-8','replace') for a in (p/'cmdline').read_bytes().split(bytes([0])) if a]
 except (OSError,PermissionError):
  unreadable+=1
  continue
 campaign=any(argv[i:i+3]==['-m','autotuner','campaign'] for i in range(len(argv)))
 binary=bool(argv) and argv[0].startswith('/var/tmp/matrix-autotuner-') and any(word in pathlib.Path(argv[0]).name for word in ('candidate','reference'))
 if campaign or binary: jobs.append({'pid':int(p.name),'argv':argv})
lock='/var/tmp/matrix-autotuner-p3-10245102457.runner.lock'
state='unknown'
try:
 with open(lock,'rb') as stream:
  try:
   fcntl.flock(stream,fcntl.LOCK_EX|fcntl.LOCK_NB)
   state='available'
   fcntl.flock(stream,fcntl.LOCK_UN)
  except BlockingIOError: state='held'
except FileNotFoundError: state='absent'
print(json.dumps({'formal_processes':jobs,'unreadable_process_count':unreadable,'runner_lock':lock,'runner_lock_state':state,'pause_marker_action':'none','settings_modified':False,'classification':'argv tokens, not substring of diagnostic source'}))
